entries.PRT-QL-085: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested for the same period in {business}. Their profit shares were {shareA} and {shareB}. If {partnerB} invested {capitalB}, find {partnerA}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-086: {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB} in {business}. If {partnerA}'s profit share was {knownShare}, find {partnerB}'s profit share.
entries.PRT-QL-087: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for the full year. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} but left before year-end. If total profit was {totalProfit} and {partnerB}'s share was {knownShare}, after how many months did {partnerB} leave?
entries.PRT-QL-088: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start and {partnerB} joined later with {capitalB}. If both received equal profit, after how many months did {partnerB} join?
entries.PRT-QL-089: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start but left before year-end, while {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. If both received equal profit, after how many months did {partnerA} leave?
entries.PRT-QL-090: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} from the start, {partnerB} joined after {joinAfterB} with {capitalB}, and {partnerC} joined after {joinAfterC} with {capitalC}. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find the difference between the profit shares of {partnerA} and {partnerB}.
entries.PRT-QL-091: {partnerA} started a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA} and withdrew {withdrawnCapital} after {changeMonthA}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. Find their profit-sharing ratio.
entries.PRT-QL-092: {partnerA} started a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA} and added {addedCapital} after {changeMonthA}. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerA}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-093: {partnerA} started a one-year {business} with {initialCapitalA}. After {changeMonthA}, the capital was changed to a new amount. {partnerB} kept {capitalB} invested throughout. What should {partnerA}'s new capital be so that both receive equal profit?
entries.PRT-QL-094: In a one-year {business}, {partnerA} changed capital from {initialCapitalA} to {finalCapitalA} after {changeMonthA}, while {partnerB} changed capital from {initialCapitalB} to {finalCapitalB} after {changeMonthB}. Find the ratio of their effective capital-time contributions.
entries.PRT-QL-095: In {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}. {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for twice {partnerA}'s period, while {partnerC} invested {capitalC} for one and a half times {partnerA}'s period. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-096: In {business}, {partnerA}, {partnerB}, and {partnerC} invested {capitalA} for {durationA}, {capitalB} for {durationB}, and {capitalC} for {durationC}, respectively. {partnerC}'s effective capital-time contribution equals the combined contributions of {partnerA} and {partnerB}. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerC}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-097: In {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB}. {partnerC} invested an unknown capital for {durationC}. If all three received equal profit, find {partnerC}'s capital.
entries.PRT-QL-098: In {business}, {partnerA} invested {capitalA} for {durationA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalB} for {durationB}. {partnerC} invested {capitalC} for an unknown duration. If all three received equal profit, find {partnerC}'s investment duration.
entries.PRT-QL-099: {partnerA} was the active partner and {partnerB} the sleeping partner in {business}. They invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period. From total profit of {totalProfit}, {partnerA} first received a salary of {salary}; the remainder was shared by capital ratio. Find {partnerB}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-100: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in {business}. Before distributing the remaining profit, {partnerA} received a fixed management allowance of {allowance}. If total profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerB}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-101: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in {business}. {partnerA}, the active partner, first received {commissionPercent}% of gross profit as commission; the remainder was then shared by capital ratio. If gross profit was {totalProfit}, find {partnerA}'s final receipt.
entries.PRT-QL-102: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in {business}. From total profit of {totalProfit}, {reserve} was first kept as reserve. The remainder was divided by capital ratio. Find {targetPartner}'s share.
entries.PRT-QL-103: {partnerA} and {partnerB} invested {capitalA} and {capitalB} for the same period in {business}. A business expense of {expense} was deducted from total profit of {totalProfit} before distribution. Find {targetPartner}'s share from the remaining profit.
